sections.heading: Opening
paragraphs: Per the file, a Proof of Stake (per the file) \(PoS\), \(i.e. using in-protocol (per the file) asset, SOL, to provide secure consensus\) (per the file) design is outlined here. Per the file, solana puts in place a proof of stake (per the file) reward/security scheme for node nodes in the cluster. Per the file, the purpose is threefold: Align node incentives with that of (per the file) the greater cluster through (per the file) skin-in-the-game deposits at risk (per the file) Avoid 'nothing at stake' fork voting issues (per the file) by implementing slashing rules aimed at promoting (per the file) fork convergence Provide an avenue for node rewards provided as a function of node participation in the cluster. Per the file, while many of the (per the file) details of the specific (per the file) implementation are currently under (per the file) consideration and are expected (per the file) to come into focus (per the file) through specific modeling studies (per the file) and parameter exploration on (per the file) the Solana testnet, we (per the file) outline here our current (per the file) thinking on the main (per the file) components of the PoS system.

Per the file, much of this thinking (per the file) is based on the (per the file) current status of Casper (per the file) FFG, with optimizations and (per the file) specific attributes to be (per the file) modified as is allowed (per the file) by Solana's Proof of (per the file) History \(PoH\) blockchain data structure. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.

sections.heading: General Overview
paragraphs: Per the file, solana's ledger validation design (per the file) is based on a rotating, (per the file) stake-weighted selected leader broadcasting txs in a PoH data structure to (per the file) validating nodes. Per the file, these nodes, upon receiving (per the file) the leader's broadcast, have (per the file) the opportunity to vote on (per the file) the current state and PoH (per the file) height by signing a tx into the PoH stream. Per the file, to become a Solana node, one must deposit/lock-up some (per the file) amount of SOL in a contract. Per the file, this SOL will not (per the file) be accessible for a specific time period. Per the file, the precise duration of (per the file) the staking lockup period (per the file) has not been determined. Per the file, however we can consider (per the file) three phases of this (per the file) time for which specific parameters is to be necessary: _Warm-up period_: (per the file) which SOL is deposited and (per the file) inaccessible to the node, however PoH tx validation has not begun.

Per the file, most likely on the (per the file) order of days to (per the file) weeks _Validation period_: a (per the file) minimum duration for which the deposited SOL is to be inaccessible, at risk (per the file) of slashing \(see slashing (per the file) rules below\) and earning rewards for the node participation. Per the file, likely duration of months (per the file) to a year. _Cool-down (per the file) period_: a duration of time (per the file) following the submission of a 'withdrawal' tx. Per the file, during this period validation (per the file) responsibilities have been removed (per the file) and the funds continue to be inaccessible. Per the file, accumulated rewards ought to be delivered at the (per the file) end of this period, (per the file) along with the return (per the file) of the initial deposit.

Per the file, solana's trustless sense of (per the file) time and ordering provided by (per the file) its PoH data structure, along (per the file) with its turbine data broadcast and transmission design, (per the file) should provide sub-second tx confirmation times that scale with the (per the file) log of the number of nodes (per the file) in the cluster. Per the file, this means we shouldn't (per the file) have to restrict the number (per the file) of validating nodes with a (per the file) prohibitive 'minimum deposits' and expect (per the file) nodes to be able to become nodes with nominal amounts of SOL staked. Per the file, at the same time, (per the file) Solana's focus on high-throughput (per the file) should create incentive for validation clients (per the file) to provide high-performant and reliable hardware.

Per the file, combined with potentially a (per the file) minimum network speed threshold (per the file) to join as a (per the file) validation-client, we expect a (per the file) healthy validation delegation market to emerge. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.

sections.heading: Penalties
paragraphs: Per the file, as discussed in the Economic Design section, annual node interest rates are to (per the file) be specified as a (per the file) function of total percentage (per the file) of circulating supply that has been staked. Per the file, the cluster rewards nodes who are online and (per the file) actively participating in the (per the file) validation process throughout the (per the file) entirety of their _validation period_. Per the file, for nodes that go offline/fail to validate txs during this period, their annual (per the file) reward is effectively reduced. Per the file, similarly, we may consider (per the file) an algorithmic reduction in a node's active staked amount in (per the file) the case that they are offline. Per the file, i.e. if a node is inactive for some amount (per the file) of time, either due to (per the file) a partition or otherwise, the (per the file) amount of their stake that (per the file) is considered ‘active’ \(eligible to (per the file) earn rewards\) may be reduced.

Per the file, this design would be (per the file) structured to help long-lived (per the file) partitions to eventually reach finality (per the file) on their respective chains as (per the file) the % of non-voting total stake (per the file) is reduced over time until a supermajority may be achieved by the active nodes in each partition. Per the file, similarly, upon re-engaging, the (per the file) ‘active’ amount staked will come (per the file) back online at some defined rate. Per the file, different rates of stake (per the file) reduction may be considered (per the file) depending on the size (per the file) of the partition/active set. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.
